message.content:
I don’t have real‑time market data, so I can’t give you the exact spot price for gold today.  Gold is quoted in U.S. dollars per troy ounce (about 31.1 g) and the price changes every few seconds during trading hours.

**How to find the current price**

| Source | What you’ll see | How to access |
|--------|-----------------|---------------|
| **Kitco** | Live spot price, charts, news | https://www.kitco.com/ |
| **Bloomberg** | Spot price, futures, market commentary | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets/commodities |
| **Reuters** | Spot price, market analysis | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities |
| **London Bullion Market Association (LBMA)** | Official spot price (LBMA Gold Price) | https://www.lbma.org.uk/ |
| **Yahoo Finance** | Spot price, historical data | https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GC=F/ |

**Typical range (as of early 2024)**  
Gold has been trading roughly between **$1,800 and $2,000 per ounce** in recent months, but the exact figure can vary by a few dollars each day.

If you need the precise price for a specific time, check one of the sites above or your brokerage platform.
